issues.desc: CHK-001 is verifiable but is phrased only as internal snapshot threading; state the observable acceptance that lifecycle readiness completes faster and more predictably without changing evidence decisions.

CHK-002 is verifiable but is phrased only as a regression seam; state the operator-visible acceptance that integrity, cutoff, and gate outcomes remain identical while repeated prompt-envelope reads are avoided.

CHK-001 identifies the snapshot-threading implementation but does not state the user-observable acceptance outcome: the lifecycle readiness check should complete faster and more predictably while preserving the same evidence decision and fail-closed checks.

CHK-002 describes an internal cached-versus-uncached regression seam but does not state the operator-facing completion signal: the readiness check should perform bounded prompt-envelope reads and produce identical integrity, scope, freshness, cutoff, and gate outcomes in both paths.
